scalars.scalar_value: RECRUITMENT PERIOD ONE MONTH: Applicants will be screened on a weekly basis. The position can be filled prior to the removal date.
Previous experience coordinating inpatient care in a multi-specialty veterinary hospital.
Minimum 5 years experience in small animal practice.
Hours to be arranged. To include nights, weekends and holidays.

items.item_text: Must be licensed to practice veterinary medicine in the state of California or obtain a California license within 6 months from date of hire if currently licensed elsewhere.
Minimum 5 years experience in small animal practice.
Previous experience coordinating inpatient care in a multi-specialty veterinary hospital.

Under the supervision of the small animal emergency and critical care faculty, oversee the management of all hospitalized cats and dogs in the intermediate, isolation and general wards. Occasional perform primary care responsibilities for stable hospitalized patients. Supervise and train fourth year veterinary students, interns, residents and technicians.
Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or foreign equivalent.
Residency training in either small animal emergency and critical care or internal medicine.
Interpersonal communication skills to work with others in a collegial team atmosphere.
